text:
```yaml
name: Nightly Workflow

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./core/...

  ci-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-and-test
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Build Docker images
        run: docker-compose build

      - name: Run production gates
        run: |
          for gate in $(seq 9 17); do
            docker-compose run --rm gate${gate}
          done

  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: ci-integration
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Clean up resources
        run: |
          docker-compose down
          rm -rf /tmp/*
```
This GitHub Actions workflow file defines three jobs: `build-and-test`, `ci-integration`, and `cleanup`. The `build-and-test` job runs the Go tests for all 23 packages. The `ci-integration` job builds Docker images and runs each of the 9 to 17 production gates using Docker Compose. The `cleanup` job cleans up resources after the integration tests have completed. The workflow is scheduled to run daily at midnight UTC and can also be triggered manually through the GitHub UI.

          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Run tests

  ci-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-and-test
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Build Docker images
        run: docker-compose build

      - name: Run production gates
        run: |
          for gate in $(seq 9 17); do
            docker-compose run --rm gate${gate}
          done

  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: ci-integration
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Clean up resources
        run: |
          docker-compose down
          rm -rf /tmp/*
